text: 内外结合，很多事情，看了国内的报道，再看看外面是怎么说的。
en: Combine inside and outside: for many things, read the domestic reporting, then look at what the outside world says.

text: 下面这两个网站不用梯子就能直接打开，上班没事时就瞎逛逛。
en: The two websites below can be opened directly without a VPN; I browse them idly when I have nothing to do at work.

text: 雅虎的很多报道是源自路透社、华盛顿邮报、华尔街日报等等。
en: Much of Yahoo's reporting comes from Reuters, The Washington Post, The Wall Street Journal and others.

text: 早报的新闻，多数都不算秘闻，但至少能看到一些这里看不到的，比如，去年8月南海的视频。
en: The Zaobao's news is mostly not secret, but at least you can see some things you cannot see here — for example, last August's video from the South China Sea.

text: 大辞海、术语库、语料库，维基百科，知网，Newdu网、Thpku网，Zlibrary，The Internet Portal（互联网传送门），Internet Archive（互联网档案馆）。
en: Da Cihai, terminology databases, corpora, Wikipedia, CNKI, Newdu, Thpku, Zlibrary, The Internet Portal, Internet Archive.

text: 以上网站基本涵盖了整个互联网的知识。
en: These websites basically cover the entire internet's knowledge.

text: 用【知识】形成认知，不要用【信息】形成认知。
en: Use 'knowledge' to form cognition, not 'information'.

text: 之所以有“茧房”，还是你对那个领域不了解。
en: The reason there is a 'cocoon' is that you do not understand that field.

text: 你专业领域就很少有“茧房“吧。
en: In your own professional field, you rarely have a 'cocoon', right?

text: 对专业不了解，就算信源很多，你也很难判断对错。
en: If you do not understand a field, even with many sources you will find it hard to judge right from wrong.

text: 所以尽可能多跨几个领域扩大知识面，知识积累多了，就没那么多“茧房”了。
en: So expand your knowledge across as many fields as possible; once you have accumulated enough knowledge, there will not be so many 'cocoons'.

text: 当美媒说美国负面新闻的时候，它是可信的，证据确凿的，是可以被印度国内权威媒体引用的
en: When the US media reports negative news about America, it is credible, well-evidenced, and can be cited by authoritative Indian domestic media.

text: 当同一家美媒说正义联盟的负面消息的时候，它是无中生有，是不可信的，是可以忽略的
en: When the same US media reports negative news about the Justice League, it is fabricated, untrustworthy, and can be ignored.

text: 这家美媒说印度的正面新闻的时候，这是可以骄傲的，可以大幅宣传的
en: When this US media reports positive news about India, it is something to be proud of and can be widely publicised.

text: 还是这家美媒说印度负面新闻的时候，这是戴有色眼镜，胡搅蛮缠，颠倒黑白，是需要全国从上至下全民慷慨激昂批判的，但是有一点要尤其注意，就算是全民批判也不能发出原文
en: But when this same US media reports negative news about India, it is wearing tinted glasses, stirring up trouble, inverting right and wrong, and needs to be criticised passionately by the whole nation from top to bottom — but one thing to be especially careful about is that even during nationwide criticism, the original text must not be circulated.

text: 这样就可以有效避免信息茧房，因为印度已经过滤了无效虚假的信息，剩下的都是真知灼见
en: This way you can effectively avoid the information cocoon, because India has already filtered out invalid, false information, and what remains is all true insight.

text: 首先我举个假想的例子：
en: First, let me give a hypothetical example:

text: 小明是一位很普通的大城市上班族，在现如今的社会环境下，小明每天八九点下班，上下班通勤一两个小时，周末不能保证双休，五险一金没缴满，加班费无偿，一个月几千块钱工资。
en: Xiao Ming is a very ordinary office worker in a big city. In today's social environment, Xiao Ming gets off work at eight or nine every evening, commutes one or two hours each way, cannot guarantee two days off on weekends, has not fully paid the five insurances and one fund, gets no overtime pay, and earns a few thousand yuan a month.

text: 整体而言，在大城市漂着的小明，大部分时间并不幸福。
en: Overall, Xiao Ming, drifting in a big city, is mostly unhappy.

text: 小明最快乐的时光，就是在上下班的地铁上，还有深夜在被窝里，刷上一些不怎么需要走脑的视频和段子，然后在那边傻乐。
en: Xiao Ming's happiest moments are on the subway commuting to and from work, and late at night under the covers, scrolling through videos and jokes that do not require much thought, and giggling foolishly.

text: 除此以外，小明还特别喜欢在各个社交网站上，就某件实事，某个游戏，某项比赛，和别人交流自己的看法。
en: Besides that, Xiao Ming particularly likes to exchange his views with others on various social websites about some real event, some game, or some competition.

text: 小明特别喜欢看那些符合自己立场的观点，小明希望这些观点的帖子写的越多越好，读起来仿佛读爽文一样内心舒适。
en: Xiao Ming particularly likes reading views that match his own position, and hopes there are as many posts with these views as possible; reading them feels as comfortable as reading a feel-good novel.

text: 而那些和自己观点不和的文章和视频，无论文章内容，视频长短，小明基本都看不下去，一头扎进评论区对线，维护自身立场神圣不可侵犯，即便有些内容其实很有道理。
en: As for articles and videos that disagree with his views, no matter the article's content or the video's length, Xiao Ming basically cannot get through them, and instead dives headfirst into the comments to argue, defending the sacred inviolability of his own position, even though some of the content actually makes a lot of sense.

text: 这样的生活过了很久，小明突然有种虚度时间的感受，千篇一律的工作下，自己好像也没啥思想和技能上的进步，是时候扩大下自己的认知了。
en: After living like this for a long time, Xiao Ming suddenly feels he has wasted his time: under the monotonous work, he seems to have made no progress in thinking or skills. It is time to broaden his cognition.

text: 那么该如何学习呢，下班回家后脑袋一片浆糊，读书这种慢慢积累的事情显然坚持不下去，难得的宝贵时间，还是尽可能用在刀刃上或者让自己乐呵乐呵比较好。
en: So how should he learn? After getting home from work, his head is mush; reading, which accumulates slowly, is clearly unsustainable. His precious spare time is better spent on what matters most or on making himself happy.

text: 这时小明想起来，自己在社交媒体上有看到很多知识类和启发类的文章视频，一边刷手机一边获取知识，岂不美哉？
en: Then Xiao Ming remembers that he has seen many knowledge and inspiration articles and videos on social media — acquiring knowledge while scrolling on his phone, wouldn't that be wonderful?

text: 于是小明拿起手机，在社交软件中搜索着。
en: So Xiao Ming picks up his phone and searches in social apps.

text: 小明没什么耐心，希望在有限的时间里学到尽可能多的干货，一般看下开头结尾，评论区看下省流的总结，就上滑下滑了。
en: Xiao Ming has little patience and hopes to learn as much substantive content as possible in limited time. He generally reads the beginning and end, checks the comments for a TL;DR summary, and then scrolls up and down.

text: 所以小明最喜欢那些几百字的短文章和几十秒的短视频，言简意赅，直接说结论和观点，在小明看来这才是又有干货又不墨迹。
en: So Xiao Ming likes short articles of a few hundred words and short videos of a few dozen seconds best: concise and to the point, directly stating conclusions and views. In Xiao Ming's view, this is substantive content without beating around the bush.

text: 至于长文长视频，看看开头，瞅一眼结尾，找一找文章和视频中的“省流观点”，如果觉得写的不错就点点赞投投币，然后直接上滑下滑了。
en: As for long articles and long videos, he reads the beginning, glances at the end, looks for the 'TL;DR view' in the article or video, and if he thinks it is well written, he likes and upvotes it, then directly scrolls on.

text: 同样的，小明还是只爱看那些符合自己立场的文章视频，其他观点不和的内容，要么瞥一眼直接略过，要么直接去评论区对线。
en: Similarly, Xiao Ming still only loves reading articles and videos that match his position; content with disagreeing views he either glances at and skips, or goes straight to the comments to argue.

text: 到了该睡觉的时间，小明放下了手机，回忆一下刚才刷到的文章和视频，好像没什么收获，啥也没记住。
en: When it is time to sleep, Xiao Ming puts down his phone and recalls the articles and videos he just scrolled through. He seems to have gained nothing and remembers nothing.

text: 算了睡觉吧，第二天还得继续加班呢。
en: Forget it, time to sleep; tomorrow he has to work overtime again.

text: 有一天，小明突然认为，自己之前的阅读方式有问题，所谓干货满满的碎片化阅读，既不讲前因后果，又不讲理论分析，内容也都是附和自己立场的爽文模式，死记硬背这些直接抛出来的知识点，自然是记不住的。
en: One day, Xiao Ming suddenly thinks his previous reading style is problematic: so-called substantive fragmented reading neither explains causes and consequences nor theoretical analysis, and its content is all feel-good essays that cater to his position. Memorising these directly presented knowledge points by rote naturally means he cannot remember them.

text: 小明认为自己陷入了碎片化阅读和奶头乐的漩涡，他决定克服困难，即便自己下班后没多少时间，也要读一读长文，看看正经的科普视频，至少小明认为，这可以让自己的生活稍微正能量一些。
en: Xiao Ming thinks he has fallen into the vortex of fragmented reading and pacifying entertainment. He decides to overcome the difficulty: even if he does not have much time after work, he will read long articles and watch proper science videos. At least, Xiao Ming thinks, this can make his life a little more positive.

text: 于是小明拿出手机，满怀信心地上滑下滑。
en: So Xiao Ming takes out his phone, full of confidence, scrolling up and down.

text: 然后小明发现，他只能搜索到那些短文章和短视频，而且这些文章视频讲述的，基本都是附和自己立场的观点。
en: Then Xiao Ming discovers that he can only search for those short articles and short videos, and what these articles and videos tell is basically views that cater to his position.

text: 小明希望的干货文章和科普视频，如果不知道它起的什么标题的话，自己已经搜索不到了，自然也就看不到。
en: The substantive articles and science videos Xiao Ming hopes for, if he does not know what title they were given, he can no longer search for them, and naturally cannot see them.

text: 小明十分苦恼，他打开了某网站，搜索话题：
en: Xiao Ming is very troubled. He opens a certain website and searches for the topic:

text: 如何避免活在信息茧房之中？
en: How can I avoid living in an information cocoon?

text: 在上面这个例子中，小明的状态多少可以反映现如今咱们的一些共同点。
en: In the above example, Xiao Ming's state can somewhat reflect some commonalities among us today.

text: 人每天的时间精力是有限的，人们在白天消耗精力，晚上通过休息恢复精力把血回满，第二天继续迎接白天的消耗，周而复始。
en: A person's time and energy each day are limited. People expend energy during the day and restore it through rest at night, replenishing their health, and then continue to face the day's consumption the next day, over and over.

text: 很多人轻视了加班的负面影响，它除了大幅压缩人们的休息时间外，还因为过长工作时间的耗竭，让人们的精力大幅受损，并因为休息和娱乐时间不够，导致第二天的精力来不及补满。
en: Many people underestimate the negative impact of overtime: besides greatly compressing people's rest time, it also greatly damages people's energy due to exhaustion from excessively long working hours, and because rest and entertainment time is insufficient, the next day's energy cannot be replenished in time.

text: 长此以往下去，精力不足会明显体现在人的精神面貌上，反应迟钝，注意力不集中，社交恐惧，对生活中的各种事情提不起兴趣，等等。
en: Over time, insufficient energy will clearly show in a person's mental state: slow reactions, lack of concentration, social fear, lack of interest in all kinds of things in life, and so on.

text: 这种“精力枯竭”的状态，让人没办法集中脑力和精神，专心认真地学习和思考一些事情，只能在闲暇和碎片化的时间当中，干一些不太走脑又能放松心情的事情。
en: This state of 'energy depletion' leaves people unable to concentrate their brainpower and spirit to seriously study and think about things; they can only, in their leisure and fragmented time, do things that do not require much thought and can relax their mood.

text: 就像小明那样，在车里，沙发上或者床上，找一个葛优瘫的姿势，看一些短视频，放松心情或者干脆傻乐呵，享受属于自己支配的自由时光。
en: Like Xiao Ming, in the car, on the sofa or in bed, finding a Ge You-style slouching pose, watching some short videos, relaxing or simply giggling foolishly, enjoying the free time under their own control.

text: 然而在这个过程中，人们虽然可以享受自由时光，并且无需消耗多少精力，但却也让人们只能接受一些无效信息。
en: However, in this process, although people can enjoy their free time and need not expend much energy, they can only accept some invalid information.

text: 从放松的角度讲，它当然是有积极意义的，但是从信息获取的角度来讲，这种无效信息的输入是不利于人们认知范围提升的，它提供的只是放松心情和支配自由时间的快感。
en: From a relaxation perspective, this certainly has positive significance, but from an information-acquisition perspective, this input of invalid information is not conducive to improving people's cognitive range; it only provides the pleasure of relaxing and controlling free time.

text: 不过仅从这点看，这还不至于让人们生活在信息茧房中，它只是阻断了人们获取有效信息的渠道和方式，让人们的认知扩展变得缓慢而已。
en: But judging from this point alone, this is not enough to make people live in an information cocoon; it only blocks people's channels and methods of obtaining effective information, making the expansion of people's cognition slower.

text: 更关键的因素在于，人们会选择性地接受那些自己青睐的信息，阻止自己反感的信息注入大脑，即便它们当中很多信息干货满满。
en: The more critical factor is that people selectively accept information they favour, and prevent information they dislike from entering their brains, even though much of it is full of substantive content.

text: 通俗来说就是，人们更倾向于寻找共鸣，而不是理性地看待别人的所有观点。
en: In plain terms, people tend to seek resonance rather than rationally view all of other people's opinions.

text: 如果在社交软件上，某个人的文章或者视频爆火，得到了很多浏览点赞和关注，这并不完全意味着它展现的观点是正确客观权威的。
en: If, on social software, someone's article or video goes viral and gets many views, likes and follows, this does not entirely mean the view it presents is correct, objective and authoritative.

text: 更准确的说法是，这个回答引起了人们的共鸣，顺应了绝大部分人既有的思想观念，因而很多人愿意仔细读一读并为此点赞关注。
en: More accurately, this answer resonated with people and conformed to most people's existing ideas, so many people are willing to read it carefully and like and follow it.

text: 反之，即便一种观点客观正确又逻辑缜密，但如果它不符合大众主流的思想观念，甚至有点超前的话，大众就会拒绝仔细阅读甚至直接略过，也就是小明在手机APP里上滑下滑的操作。
en: Conversely, even if a view is objectively correct and logically rigorous, if it does not conform to the mainstream ideas of the masses, or is even a bit ahead of its time, the masses will refuse to read it carefully or even skip it directly — which is Xiao Ming's scrolling up and down in his phone app.

text: 暴躁一些的，看到与自己不合的观点，不光是连读都不读，更会借助社交软件的相关功能，用自己的观点直接和别人对线争论。
en: The more irritable ones, upon seeing views that disagree with them, do not even read them, but use the social software's relevant functions to directly argue with others using their own views.

text: 上面描述的这种情况，普遍存在于各种话题中，特别是那些没有固定答案的，每个人可以各抒己见的开放性话题上，连答案较为固定的科学类话题都不能避免。
en: The situation described above is common across all kinds of topics, especially those open topics with no fixed answers, where everyone can express their own views, and even science topics with relatively fixed answers cannot avoid it.

text: 人的这种心理倾向，会自发地拒绝外界信息的注入，让自己的认知难以扩大。
en: This psychological tendency of people spontaneously rejects the injection of outside information, making it difficult for their cognition to expand.

text: 长此以往下去，人会逐渐构筑一个封闭自洽的自我世界，并在这个世界中获得安全感和舒适体验。
en: Over time, people gradually build a closed, self-consistent inner world, and gain a sense of security and comfort in this world.

text: 这就像吐丝的蚕宝宝一样，把自己封闭在一个狭小但是安全的空间内，信息茧房由此出现。
en: This is like a silkworm spinning silk, enclosing itself in a small but safe space, and the information cocoon thus appears.

text: 而高压的社会环境，则会加剧这种信息茧房的形成，让蚕宝宝们更加急于寻找这种安全感和舒适体验，习惯于缩在茧房内把自己保护起来。
en: A high-pressure social environment aggravates the formation of this information cocoon, making the silkworms even more eager to find this sense of security and comfort, accustomed to shrinking inside the cocoon to protect themselves.

text: 当一位上班被领导骂，开会和同事拌嘴，想正常下班却被迫加班摸鱼的打工人，终于熬到下班的那一刻时，全身已经积累一大堆负能量了。
en: When a working stiff who was scolded by their boss at work, bickered with colleagues in meetings, and wanted to get off work normally but was forced to work overtime and slack off, finally reaches the moment of getting off work, their whole body has accumulated a pile of negative energy.

text: 这种情况下，人们更希望追求内心的愉悦和舒适感，活在一个以自我为中心的世界中，而不是活在那个以老板为中心，需要想办法和他人相处共存的世界中。
en: In this situation, people prefer to pursue inner pleasure and comfort, living in a world centred on themselves, rather than living in a world centred on the boss, where they need to figure out how to get along and coexist with others.

text: 人们希望打游戏百战百胜，希望小事琐事一切顺利，希望看到让自己舒服的言论。
en: People hope to win every game, hope everything small goes smoothly, and hope to see statements that make them comfortable.

text: 对于与自己观点不和的内容，人们会据理力争，最好把别人一次性驳倒，体验那种捍卫自己立场的快感，工作生活不易，再给自己找不爽快，那就是找罪受。
en: For content that disagrees with their views, people will argue with reason, preferably refuting the other person in one go, experiencing the pleasure of defending their position. Work and life are not easy; finding more unpleasantness for oneself is asking for trouble.

text: 而在这样的心态中，信息茧房也变得更快构建，茧房本身也变得更厚更难戳破，越来越多的人选择缩在茧房里不出来，信息茧房成为当代人热议的话题，也就不奇怪了。
en: And in this mindset, the information cocoon is built even faster, the cocoon itself becomes thicker and harder to puncture, and more and more people choose to stay inside the cocoon and not come out. It is no wonder the information cocoon has become a hot topic among contemporary people.

text: 最后，发现人们处在信息茧房中的洞察者，未必会选择善意的提醒。
en: Finally, those who perceive that people are in information cocoons may not necessarily choose to kindly remind them.

text: 互联网公司知道现代人的信息茧房很严重，但它们肯定不会选择戳破茧房，而是借助这一点，尽可能地将蚕宝宝们更想看到的信息精准推送。
en: Internet companies know that modern people's information cocoons are severe, but they certainly will not choose to puncture the cocoon; instead, they will use this to push information that the silkworms want to see even more precisely.

text: 于是当小明发现自己处在碎片化阅读中难以自拔，想要改变点什么的时候，除非主动搜索，否则广告和信息推送已经全都是短视频短文章附和的观点了。
en: So when Xiao Ming finds himself unable to extricate himself from fragmented reading and wants to change something, unless he actively searches, the advertisements and information pushes are already all short videos and short articles with conforming views.

text: 同样的，一个人如果想得到大量的舆论支持，只需要借助自身势力，将信息进行人为筛选，然后将那些有利于自己的信息注入到蚕宝宝的茧中。
en: Similarly, if a person wants to gain a lot of public support, they only need to use their own power to manually filter information, and then inject information favourable to themselves into the silkworms' cocoons.

text: 这样，这个人就可以收获一大堆狂热的粉丝，无论这个人做的对还是不对，它都会得到一众无脑追随的蚕宝宝们。
en: In this way, this person can harvest a large group of fanatical fans; no matter whether this person is right or wrong, they will gain a crowd of mindless following silkworms.

text: 而那些善意提醒的好心人，甚至会被蚕宝宝认为是坏人，因为这些好心人的建议与它们希望看到的言论是不相符的，蚕宝宝们会自发地捍卫自己的立场。
en: And those well-meaning people who kindly remind them may even be regarded as bad people by the silkworms, because these good people's suggestions do not match the statements they hope to see, and the silkworms will spontaneously defend their positions.

text: 就好比高明的骗子骗了一个人之后，如果好心人提醒它上当受骗了，它反而会骂那个好心人一顿，然后对骗子说一句：“谢谢啊”
en: It is like a skilled liar who deceives a person; if a good person reminds them they have been deceived, they will instead scold the good person, and then say to the liar: 'Thank you'.

text: 至于避免活在信息茧房中的方法，根据前面的分析探讨，可以总结出几种有效的方向：
en: As for methods to avoid living in an information cocoon, based on the preceding analysis and discussion, several effective directions can be summarised:

text: 1.想办法逃离那些过于耗竭时间精力的工作，确保自己有足够的时间精力辨别和接受信息。
en: 1. Find ways to escape work that excessively drains time and energy, ensuring you have enough time and energy to distinguish and accept information.

text: 2.将更多时间放在精细化的信息获取上，无论是看书听课还是浏览更有质量的文章视频。
en: 2. Spend more time on refined information acquisition, whether reading books, taking courses, or browsing higher-quality articles and videos.

text: 3.勤于思考，特别是基于已有事实的思想推演，往往能得到客观事实或者较为准确的预测。
en: 3. Think diligently, especially ideological deduction based on existing facts, which often yields objective facts or relatively accurate predictions.

text: 4.尝试浏览与自己既有观点不太相符的干货内容，适度地克服人性以扩展自己的认知。
en: 4. Try browsing substantive content that does not quite match your existing views, moderately overcoming human nature to expand your cognition.

text: 5.扩大信息获取的渠道，通过多种渠道组合信息，得到客观真相并作出正确判断。
en: 5. Expand the channels for obtaining information, and combine information through multiple channels to obtain objective truth and make correct judgments.

text: 最后说一下，信息茧房并不见得一定是坏事，很多人知道的越多反而越痛苦。
en: Finally, the information cocoon is not necessarily a bad thing; the more many people know, the more pain they feel.

text: 相比之下，活在自洽的小空间里，反而是件比较舒适的事情。
en: In comparison, living in a self-consistent little space is a more comfortable thing.

text: 而如果一位蚕宝宝的茧房破裂，蚕宝宝看到了外面的世界，被迫重建认知的话。
en: And if a silkworm's cocoon breaks, and the silkworm sees the outside world and is forced to rebuild its cognition.

text: 对于蚕宝宝来说，这会是个非常痛苦的经历，但也可能是破茧成蝶和强大的开始。
en: For the silkworm, this will be a very painful experience, but it may also be the beginning of breaking out of the cocoon, becoming a butterfly, and becoming strong.

text: 个人观点，仅供参考。
en: Personal views, for reference only.
